page: Amazon Web Services r6in.12xlarge is a memory-optimized instance running on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. It is powered by an x86_64 third-generation Intel Xeon Scalable 8375C processor operating at 3.5 GHz. The instance provisions 48 dedicated virtual CPUs across 24 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The CPU cache layout includes 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and a shared 54 MB L3 cache. Supported instruction set extensions include AVX-512 (with VNNI support), AES, VAES, SHA-NI, and BMI2.

System memory consists of 384 GB of DDR4 RAM clocked at 3 GHz, providing an allocation of 8 GB per virtual core. This 1:8 core-to-memory ratio aligns with memory-intensive compute requirements. The r6in.12xlarge includes no bundled local instance storage, requiring workloads to rely on remote storage solutions such as Amazon EBS. Networking capability is elevated compared to standard memory-optimized instances, delivering a 75 Gbps baseline network bandwidth without requiring a burst mechanism.

Benchmark results place the instance in the middle 50 percent across standard compute and memory benchmarks, including a PassMark CPU score of 48,196.43 and a multi-core Geekbench score of 15,528.0. It demonstrates top-quartile performance in cryptographic throughput with a PassMark CPU encryption score of 43,336.17, as well as top-quartile results in Geekbench ray tracing and image processing. Memory benchmarks record large-block uncached read speeds of 161.35 GB/sec and write speeds of 68.61 GB/sec, supporting 49.56 million Redis SET operations per second.

The r6in.12xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for organizations requiring high network throughput alongside high memory density without paying for unused GPU silicon or dedicated local NVMe drives. Tradeoffs include total reliance on network-attached storage for persistence. Suitable workloads include distributed in-memory databases, large Redis clusters, SAP HANA installations, real-time analytics engines, and network-heavy enterprise caching layers.
description: Amazon Web Services r6in.12xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor and driven by an Intel Xeon 8375C processor operating at 3.5 GHz. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs (24 physical cores), a 54 MB L3 cache, and instruction support including AVX-512 and cryptographic accelerators like VAES and SHA-NI. The instance contains 384 GB of DDR4 system memory running at 3 GHz, delivering an 8 GB per core memory profile. Bundled local storage is absent, directing persistent I/O through Amazon EBS, while networking throughput is anchored by a baseline bandwidth of 75 Gbps. In benchmark evaluations, it demonstrates strong performance in cryptographic operations, ray tracing, and image processing, coupled with high sustained memory throughput yielding 49.56 million Redis SET operations per second. The instance is designed for memory-heavy, network-intensive workloads including in-memory databases, real-time analytics, and enterprise data processing.
